# Parse the note content to extract songs
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Match pattern: Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
        match = re.match(r'(.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)$', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in match.group(2).split(',')]
            release = match.group(3).strip()
            songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release})

print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}")
for s in songs:
    print(s)
